transfer.rationale: ST1 R4c-hook checkpoint (frozen from the current-base scratch dry run at ca161e71 before the move; the operator asked in chat to complete R4 and self-validate, so it is reported with this commit rather than at a separate stop). App-to-hook transfer of 137 range lines (128 non-blank) for the Capacity mapping draft cluster, in two exports of one file to preserve effect order: a state layer called at the old state position and an effects layer carrying the project and field search-index clamps at their original position (each crosses zero unmoved effects; at the state position each would cross 39). The capacity loadConfig seed becomes one inline seam call at its exact original position, between the board seed seam and applyPriorityWeightsLoaded; it takes the load response config as a third argument because the verbatim seed reads config.authMode and config.capacityMutationEnabled, which are not in sharedConfig. The render-time snapshot assignment stays in App with its 10 keys and reads the returned draftSnapshot string. The combined App-plus-owner total grows only by the 121-line scaffolding allowance (72 hook scaffolding + 53 App scaffolding - 2 orphaned imports - 2 range blank lines not carried into the hook). dashboard.jsx lineCeiling 14412 is carried (R5 ratchets). The combined ceiling is measured-plus-allowance.
